children.text: Based in Tangará da Serra, Mato Grosso, Grupo PA combines specialized agronomic consulting with personalized support to help producers achieve higher productivity. With our own experimental field, we turn research and practical studies into reliable data, eliminating guesswork and optimizing the results of your harvest.

We simplify your operations by managing the entire procurement process for agricultural inputs, negotiating the best prices, terms, and suppliers available in the market. As pioneers in precision agriculture, we use GPS technology and remote sensing to collect accurate data and maximize the performance of every hectare. We are the reliable and profitable partner you need in the field. Count on Grupo PA to take your production to the next level.

We contribute to the development of agribusiness, delivering to our clients the best productivity solutions, with excellence in services, technology, research, and respect for people and the environment.
We aim to be a reference in agronomic consulting, research, and precision agriculture, bringing innovation, results, and trust to farmers in every season.

We believe that great results start with strong relationships. That is why we conduct our work with honesty, ethics, and transparency, valuing people, respecting every partnership, and maintaining our passion for what we do in every field challenge.

Grupo PA began its journey in Mato Grosso in 1993 with the acquisition of São Paulo Farm in Diamantino, Mato Grosso, for the cultivation of soybeans and corn. To this day, it remains the group's main farm and is home to our research field.

In 2002, our founder, Paulo Asunção, began providing agronomic consulting services at the invitation of a neighboring farmer. This became the company’s first client, and that partnership continues to this day.
In 2009, PA Consultoria began offering precision agriculture services, becoming one of the first companies in the state to provide this solution.
We began our Agronomic Research activities, which today include a 60-hectare area dedicated to development and innovation, generating valuable results for building the best production strategy.
PA Pesquisa held its first field day at its research farm at São Paulo Farm, bringing together around 30 producers.
PA Consultoria began serving the cotton crop.
PA Consultoria began providing services for cotton production.
Committed to our mission of contributing to the development of agribusiness, we expanded our operations and began serving the Northern region of Mato Grosso.

children.text: Research has always been part of the PA Group’s history. It was born from the desire to better understand the field, test new technologies, and find answers to the challenges that are part of every farmer’s daily routine. Since 2011, we have operated our own experimental station, where we evaluate cultivars, products, management practices, and emerging technologies in soybean, corn, cotton, and other crops.

More than 60 hectares are dedicated exclusively to research, generating information under real field conditions. Every season, thousands of treatments are evaluated. In the most recent season alone, our team conducted more than 2,000 treatments. All of this work contributes to one of the PA Group’s most valuable assets: knowledge built over years of observation, comparison, and practical validation.

This commitment to excellence has brought the PA Group closer to some of the world’s leading agribusiness companies, which rely on our services to evaluate technologies and generate insights that help shape the future of agriculture. Research does not end with data collection—it gains value when it becomes useful information for those working in the field. The results of our trials are shared with growers and partner companies, supporting more confident decision-making and more efficient crop management practices.

All the information delivered to our clients and to participants of the PA Summit has first passed through our research fields. Before making recommendations, we prefer to test. Before expressing an opinion, we seek data. And before bringing a technology to producers, we want to understand how it truly performs under field conditions. Research is one of the ways we continue to evolve while helping agriculture evolve alongside us.

Procurement management goes far beyond price negotiation. Our work is focused on developing strategies that bring greater efficiency, security, and profitability to rural producers by analyzing the best purchasing timing, suppliers, market opportunities, and the cost-benefit of each investment made.
We manage the acquisition of agricultural machinery, equipment, and inputs, strengthening our clients’ negotiation power and contributing to more assertive decisions within their operations.
With technical knowledge and a strategic vision of the agricultural market, we seek alternatives that combine operational performance, durability, and economic feasibility.

Beyond commercial analysis, we monitor market trends, price fluctuations, and new technologies available, allowing producers to have greater clarity and confidence when making investments. Our goal is to transform purchasing into a strategic tool to improve field results and optimize agricultural operation costs.
Today, Grupo PA manages millions in procurement operations, building strong relationships with partners and suppliers to create better opportunities for the producers we serve.

children.text: Agronomic research is one of the pillars of Grupo PA. We continuously invest in field studies and validations to develop more efficient, sustainable solutions aligned with the reality of rural producers.

Our goal is to transform data and experiments into practical strategies that contribute to increasing crop productivity and profitability. We currently have more than 60 hectares dedicated exclusively to research, where we conduct trials involving cultivars, soil fertility, crop protection management, input positioning, climate impacts, and new technologies applied to agriculture.

Each experiment is conducted with technical monitoring and detailed analysis of the results obtained in the field. Through research, we gain a deeper understanding of crop behavior and anticipate solutions for the challenges faced by producers. This allows us to generate reliable information, reduce risks, and support more assertive decision-making within agricultural operations.
Our commitment is to bring innovation closer to field practices, connecting science, technology, and agronomic expertise to drive sustainable results in agribusiness.

The results of an application do not always depend solely on the product used. Equipment calibration and operational quality make all the difference in ensuring that the management practices deliver the expected results.

Through the partnership between PA Consultoria and Kimberlit, consulting clients have access to UniTA, a service that evaluates the quality of applications carried out on the farm and identifies opportunities for improvement in equipment and operations.

The work is performed directly on the property, analyzing details that impact spraying efficiency and helping ensure that the management practices recommended by the technical team are executed in the best possible way.
Often, small adjustments can generate significant gains in efficiency, reduce losses, and improve the utilization of products applied to the crop.

UniTA is an exclusive benefit for PA Consultoria clients and comes at no additional cost. It is another tool to support decision-making in the field and help producers achieve the maximum results from every application.

children.text: PA Consultoria was born from the field and built its reputation by delivering what truly matters to producers: reliable information for decision-making. Behind the company is a farming family that, for more than three decades, has experienced the challenges of agriculture firsthand. This essence remains with us to this day.
In addition to being consultants and researchers, we continue to be producers, facing the same challenges, opportunities, and risks of every harvest.

This experience has shaped the way we work. We believe that a recommendation only has value when it works within the reality of each farm. That is why we combine practical experience, agronomic research, and technical support to transform knowledge into results.

With a solid research structure, we generate our own data and insights. This knowledge is validated in the field and directly applied to our clients’ realities, ensuring independent, reliable recommendations aligned with the needs of each property.

Throughout our journey, we have earned the trust of hundreds of producers and become a benchmark in agronomic consulting, research, and knowledge generation for agribusiness. Our credibility is the result of work built on close relationships, excellence, and a commitment to delivering results.
We are strategic partners for producers seeking productivity, efficiency, sustainability, and confidence in their decision-making.

testimonials.quote: What I like most about the team is that they are not office consultants. They are always here at the farm, entering the field, looking at pests up close, and discussing management with me in the yard. It's technical support that gives a lot of confidence when making decisions.

We bought new machinery and various digital tools, but we were missing the hands and training to get everything running. The PA team unlocked that for us, generating the application maps we needed to save on inputs.

We already harvested well, but the cost side was a bit disorganized, everything in our heads or in a notebook. They helped organize the harvest numbers and see where the money was going. Today the farm runs much more professionally.

Working with PA took a big worry off my mind. I know that the recommendation, soil profile, and technical monitoring are well handled by people who know what they're doing, so I can focus on other aspects of the business.
